test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/167be3e37b7a1963a44b36e6cdbb08d7a0f9ab4639c7bb29663587ee8e1f0755.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is: 

 1. __**The pattern of star**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a463f012119fb481a668ae5fc8e605e4ee119cd72669c7908c3850891a4e5b3.png] : The star is simply moving forward to the next consecutive corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f2f0f5edc6b4a7489b499a17a30fd39018f8b81471af5a2993792dd213486de.png] 

 2. __**The pattern of diamond **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28dc71199019d2fc4fec5ccc4f39f8e6830eb79d165c345f17658bb54a5fec2c.png] : The diamond is moving to consecutive next corner as well as it is rotating in the clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d386843c4847458ce05c14662e31e0da79ddf6f7666e34b30fd22eec1ee6a4fe.png] 

 3. __**The pattern of arrow**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/479fae4711409e962db8df9dd65db5980d0ecc970adda6c5e9b3ded7e8b10487.png] : The arrow is fixed in the middle but is rotating in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ee63a9b253b4116bddaf9290b5857c7749e1a0f3e2abc6b0c72485c4da4739b.png] 

 4. __**The pattern of color:**__ The arrow is white colored in each box, the diamond is black colored in each box, but the star is black colored in one and white in the next.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d117766caa2d45ae6e4346aca15f99b68bceeb08575dc1f3b9b4ae4ff80e5081.png] 

 ** Hence, the correct answer is:** *The figure that will replace question mark '?' in the given series is* **Option 4**.
